name: pnp-spfx-copilot-components-cafeteria
title: Cafeteria - Browse Cafeterias and Menus in Copilot
shortDescription: Browse cafeteria hours, menus, and dish options from Microsoft Copilot.
longDescription: Cafeteria brings cafeteria listings, daily menus, dish search, and cafeteria details into Microsoft Copilot through four SPFx Copilot Component tools. Users can find cafeterias by building or open status, view a menu by cafeteria and date, search dishes by name or dietary and price criteria, and check hours, contact, and payment information.
The sample uses bundled synthetic data, supports inline and full-screen display modes, and requires no live SharePoint or Microsoft Graph connection.
